name: baton
description: Pass tasks between named Claude Code sessions: the receiver queues them, works each to a pull request, reports back and picks up the next. A band and panel show your sessions and tasks.

branch_rule.title: Branch rule
branch_rule.description: How the receiving session names the branch for a passed task. A repo's own instructions win when they name one.
branch_rule.default: Branch off an up-to-date default branch as `<type>/<short-kebab-slug>`, type one of feat, fix, chore, refactor, perf, docs.

hidden_sessions.title: Hidden sessions
hidden_sessions.description: A regular expression. Sessions whose names match it are left out of the band and cannot be passed to. Default hides claude-mem's observer sessions.
